fields.summary: The ship-change run's last step, ship, fails after close-out because `rhiza ship command` starts from the run's worktree, which close-out has removed. shipCommandDir runs git from that folder, so it falls back to the gone path. Owner decision: the ship command finds the main checkout from the git common dir, as ship's own target already does, and keeps the project-root subfolder. The owner chose this option from the agent's offered options (accepted by the owner); no owner words were typed. Still open: nothing.
fields.title: Ship step after close-out, with the owner
